item.title: Husker basketball's successful season and its impact on the youth
item.description: Shoot 360 says they've had huskers in their gym before, and states it’s really cool to see this year's team set the standard for the next generation.

item.title: Cool start to the week, then a warm up
item.description: After a cool start to the week, we'll warm up quite a bit by Wednesday. More 70s and 80s are in the forecast!

item.title: Chilly Monday Before Another Warmup
item.description: Today will be chilly and cloudy across the state. A small chance for drizzle from 10am-3pm. A big warmup Tuesday & Wednesday!

item.title: Creighton's Greg McDermott to retire at the end of the season
item.description: During his time at Creighton, McDermott led the Bluejays to 14 seasons of 20-plus wins and 12 NCAA Tournament wins.

item.title: Portion of popular Lincoln street set to close Tuesday
item.description: Starting Tuesday, Havelock Avenue between 70th and 84th streets will be closed for emergency repairs to a private water service.

item.title: Warming back up this week
item.description: The warmest day of the week will be Wednesday when highs will be very close to 90 degrees. We may see a few record highs!

item.title: City of Lincoln opens application process for water quality landscape funding
item.description: Lincolnites can now apply for the Rainscaping Lincoln-Sustainable Landscapes Cost Share Program until April 24 or until funding runs out.

item.title: Online tool connects farmers with available land to cattle ranchers in need of grazing area after wildfires
item.description: "We're seeing tremendous amounts of generosity; tragedies like wildfire just really bring out the best in the AG community,"

item.title: Midday Interview: Southview Baptist Church Easter Performance
item.description: It's called “This Day of Resurrection” and the first show will be March 25. The director joined Channel 8 News at midday to discuss.

item.title: Warm Tuesday Before Hot Wednesday
item.description: A warm & breezy day across the state. Wednesday brings more record heat and fire weather. Active weather next week.
